activity.emptyBody: When {name} works, talks or delivers something, it shows up here.

teach.title: Teach persona
teach.retention: Recording is deleted after 30 days. Change this in Rules.
teach.consentIntro: We'll record what you do on screen to build steps {name} can learn.
teach.consentScreen: Only the screen or window you choose. No sound is recorded: whatever you want to tell, you write afterwards.
teach.consentLocal: On this device, in the persona's private folder. Nothing uploads to the cloud.
teach.consentPrivate: Only you. It becomes a skill only after you review and approve.
teach.recordingHint: Avoid showing passwords or sensitive data on screen.
teach.mockHint: Sample steps while the real recording gets ready.
teach.doneBody: Candidate skill saved. Review it under Skills before activating.
teach.sourceHint: Only what you choose is recorded. Close passwords and customer data before you start.
teach.sourceEmpty: I could not find anything to record right now. Open what you want to teach and look again.
teach.sourceError: I could not list screens and windows right now.
teach.beginFailed: I could not start recording. Check that Persona may see the screen and try again.
teach.needsDesktop: Teaching records this computer's screen and only works in the installed Persona app.
teach.exampleMode: Example mode: nothing is really recorded.
teach.narrateTitle: Want to tell what you did?
teach.narrateBody: Write in your own words what was done and why. It helps {name} understand the reason for each step. Do not include passwords.
teach.narrateHint: Optional. Without text, {name} describes only what was seen on screen.
teach.discardImages: Do not keep the recording images
teach.discardImagesHint: {name} learns from the text only and the images are deleted from this computer.
teach.studyingTitle: {name} is building the step by step
teach.studyingHint: It can take a few seconds. Nothing leaves this computer.
teach.review.title: Review what {name} learned
teach.review.subtitle: Adjust the steps as if you were explaining to someone new. Nothing counts until you save.
teach.review.candidateNote: Candidate: {name} tries it before really using it. You turn it on whenever you like.
teach.review.blank: Some steps are blank. They will not be saved.
teach.review.needStep: Write at least one step to save.
teach.step.limit: Step limit reached. Split it into two skills.
teach.empty.title: I could not split this recording into steps
teach.empty.body: You can write the steps yourself, or record again more slowly.
teach.failed.title: I could not finish the step by step
teach.failed.body: The recording stays on this computer only. You can try again.
teach.error.generic: I could not save right now. Try again.
teach.error.tools: This skill uses tools {name} does not have yet. Ask for their approval before turning it on.
teach.error.forbidden: Only whoever looks after this persona can do that.
teach.error.notFound: That recording is no longer here. Record again to teach.
teach.done.title: {name} learned “{skill}”
teach.done.body: They do not use it in real work yet. Turn it on when you are ready, or leave it as a candidate.
teach.done.activeBody: {name} can use it in real work now. You can go back at any time.
teach.done.reverted: Back to candidate. {name} no longer uses it.
teach.share.title: Who else can use it?
teach.share.confirm: I understand other personas will be able to use this skill.
teach.live.reviewReady: The step by step is ready to review.
teach.share.projectBody: Personas in this project will be able to use it.
teach.share.teamBody: Every persona on the team will be able to use it.
teach.discardConfirm.title: Discard the step by step?
teach.discardConfirm.body: You lose what you edited. The recording leaves this computer after the retention period.
teach.review.whatIsSkill: A skill is what {name} knows how to do, step by step.
teach.needsDesktopShort: Only works in the installed app.
teach.sourcePickHint: Choose a screen or window to continue.
teach.share.confirmHint: Tick that you understand to continue.
card.now.draft: {name} is changing {count} files in a draft. Nothing changes in your folder until you apply.
card.now.draft.one: {name} is changing 1 file in a draft. Nothing changes in your folder until you apply.
teach.done.activeTitleGeneric: The new skill is on for {name}
teach.review.nameHint: This is what {name} will call it.
teach.review.needName: Give the skill a name to save it.
teach.done.revertHint: {name} stops using it and it goes back to being a candidate.

engine.modelHint.haiku: Fastest · uses less of your limit

engine.effortNone: This engine doesn't let you choose the effort.
engine.effortFellBack: {name} used the engine default: the "{level}" level isn't available right now.

engine.effortHint.xhigh: Much more careful, uses more of your limit
engine.effortHint.ultra: Beyond max: slowest, uses the most
